question: Choose the correct meaning of idiom: '**Face the music'**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e., Bear consequences.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Face the music"** means to accept and deal with the negative consequences of one's actions or decisions. (अपने कार्यों के परिणामों को स्वीकार करना और उनसे निपटना)

 
 
• **Example:** After failing to complete the project on time, John had to face the music during the team meeting.
 
 
 
• **Bear consequences** refers to the act of accepting responsibility for something that has gone wrong or for one's actions. (परिणाम भुगतना)
 
 
• **Example: **She had to bear the consequences of her decision to skip the important meeting.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the meaning of **"Face the music"** aligns with **"Bear consequences"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Poor Weather** (खराब मौसम): Refers to unfavorable or bad weather conditions.

 
 
• **Example:** The trip was canceled due to poor weather.
 
 
 
• **Earn Money** (पैसे कमाना): Refers to making an income through work or business activities.
 
 
• **Example:** He works hard every day to earn money for his family.
 
 
 
• **Give Money** (पैसे देना): Refers to the act of offering or donating money to someone.
 
 
• **Example:** She decided to give money to the charity for a good cause.
